name: dsh-agent-memory-backpack
description: Agent Memory Backpack shared knowledge adapter for DeepSeek Harness with management UI

verifiedWith.note: Versions this adapter was actually exercised against. A host outside this list is supported on a best-effort basis: capabilities are probed at load time and a missing one fails loudly rather than degrading silently.

noClientHalf.note: This plugin deliberately declares no dsh.client browser half. Its UI is a separate Electron application that talks to the core directly, so there is nothing for the host's client module loader to mount. Declaring one would require a window.__ModuleLoader__ bundle and would fail at load time.
